newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks end lower on weak futures, profit taking.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks end lower on weak futures, profit taking.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks closed sharply lower on Thursday, with late afternoon profit-taking wiping out the morning's fragile gains, brokers said.
"The market was led down partly by futures trading and partly by profit-taking," said Peter Lui, institutional sales manager at NAVA SC Securities.
The Hang Seng Index ended 81.15 points down at 12,055.17 after swinging widely, hitting an opening low of 12,013.51, then clambering to a midday high of 12,270.66 before tumbling again.
Turnover was a respectable HK$6.98 billion, though down from Wednesday's HK$7.06 billion.
